name: tracker-planning-stages
goal: Prove planning stages, stage artifacts and attributed promotion through the Tracker journal, CLI, and the shared Mac and iPhone item views.

evidence: Committed specification defines stage order and explicit promotion, per-stage artifacts, compatibility, CLI and Mac/iPhone acceptance.
The CLI and local API journal one promotion per target and stage-specific artifacts. The Mac and iPhone show the stage and artifacts through their existing data sources.

Frozen API red a8df372d84 and green 3cccec7dbb. At 74bfd2eb22 27 focused Tracker tests, 3 Mac Electron viewport cases and 8 iPhone renderer cases passed. Signed node E2E passed four cases at c2aca38451 and native Swift checks passed 370 assertions in each build configuration at fc58926b24.
